steps.what: Collect family-approved facts, personal wording and newspaper requirements for obituaries
Draft and check personal obituary wording from the family's own account

loop.purpose: Suggest respectful personal wording from the family's supplied words
loop.input: Family wording and verified facts from s1
loop.check: Attendant checks every assertion against the family account and removes invented biography or sentiments
loop.stop: Two alternatives and one revision; unresolved tone returns to manual wording with the family
loop.why_not_simpler: Personal expression needs language judgement beyond filling factual fields

steps.what: Format the obituary proof using the selected newspaper template and verified fields
Check the obituary proof with the family and resolve wording or factual corrections

tasks.design: Keep family fact gathering and proof discussion personal. Draft optional wording in {DOCS} and format the checked text in {OTHER}, a newspaper notice editor, before the final proof review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Personal wording and newspaper formatting require separate kinds of care.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest identifies native newspaper-notice preparation services; a small reviewed wording loop is an E1 addition.
tasks.still_hard: Names, relationships, tone and late family corrections.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant listens to the family and checks that the notice says what they intended.
tasks.altitude: Prepare a consistent proof while preserving the family conversation.

reach.task: Arrange final publication after the preparation handoff
reach.learn: Which newspaper proof and deadline rules must be supplied

evidence.claim: Rouwadvertentiemaken.nl supports building and placing newspaper death notices and checking newspaper requirements.
A reviewed personal-wording assistant and the saving scenario are unmeasured proposals.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation through checked final proof; paid placement and publication approval belong to the funeral arranger and receive no saving here.

The family supplies names, relationships, dates, ceremony details and wishes; the attendant verifies and captures those exact fields and paper dimensions in s1. Attendant checks personal text in s2. Missing facts halt s3 for manual resolution; no biography is inferred.
The family produces feedback only after seeing the s3 proof during s4; the attendant's discussion and correction time stays counted.
Test the existing notice editor first; if it already formats notices, that existing runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Share of time spent on personal wording
research_questions: Can reviewed wording drafts shorten preparation without extra family corrections?

already_counted.description: Fact gathering and family proof discussion

incremental.description: Maintain newspaper templates and sample wording accuracy
Additional choice discussion if multiple personal passages are offered

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+21+0+20=71; gross 29 minus focal upkeep 5 gives net 24 in an E1 scenario. Range 0-12 allows existing template use and extra personal-wording discussion.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Obtain burial permits and register the death

steps.what: Collect and verify identity documents and authority-specific requirements for burial permits
Populate registration and burial-permit forms from verified filing fields
Check the exact registration and permit package and submit through the authorised channel
Obtain burial permits, check authority responses and resolve rejected or incomplete filings

tasks.design: Reuse checked filing fields through native form population in {GOV_PORTAL} where available. Keep submission and permit-response checks with the attendant and retain the documents in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same verified facts may be entered into several authority forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form population can replace repeated copying when the authority supports it.
tasks.still_hard: Local document requirements, authorisation, rejected filings and permit validity.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant checks the filing context and resolves issues with the authority.
tasks.altitude: Track a checked filing from preparation through official response.

reach.task: Confirm required documents and authorised filer
reach.learn: Which local requirements must be verified before submission

evidence.claim: Reusing verified fields in supported official forms is plausible, but no specific permit integration or saving is established by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary starts with signed death documents already produced by the authorised clinician and ends with checked permit and registration responses; clinical certification itself is outside this task.

Attendant verifies and captures name, identifier, death date and place, applicant identity, authority, requested form and attachment references in s1 against actual documents and current instructions. These exact fields feed s2; absent native support or missing fields means manual form entry.
The registration authority produces its response only after s3; s4 includes obtaining and checking it. A submission receipt is not a permit.
Test native portal reuse first; existing automatic population receives no labour saving. National filing rules and authority access must be confirmed.
research_questions: Which fields can be reused reliably without changing the authority's filing process?

already_counted.description: Document verification, submission approval and response exceptions

incremental.description: Check changed authority forms and maintain field mapping

approvals.approved_version: Exact authority, registration and permit form versions, subject identifiers, declarations and attachment set; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+20+20=75; gross 25 minus focal upkeep 6 gives net 19 as an E1 scenario. Range 0-5 reflects local portal limitations, existing autofill and infrequent reuse.

tasks.short: Obtain doctors' signatures and complete insurance paperwork

steps.what: Obtain doctors' signatures on death documents and check receipt of the signed versions
Verify insurance claim facts and capture fields from family and insurer documents
Populate insurance claims forms with the verified fields and attachment references
Check completed paperwork and return unresolved declarations or missing signatures to the responsible person

tasks.design: Keep obtaining signed clinical documents with the attendant. Reuse verified nonclinical claim fields in {DOCS}, then check the completed draft before handing it to the responsible filer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Claim forms can repeat information already available in signed documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document fields can populate standard forms without generating clinical statements.
tasks.still_hard: Receiving signatures, confirming claimant information and identifying declarations only another person can make.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant follows up with the right person and recognises unresolved authority or identity questions.
tasks.altitude: Prepare consistent paperwork while retaining signature follow-up.

reach.task: Confirm who may sign and file the insurance claim
reach.learn: Which declarations need the claimant's own answer

evidence.claim: Native document population can reuse checked claim facts; signature acquisition and clinical certification remain unchanged.

assumptions: Boundary covers obtaining signed documents and completing a draft claim, not the clinician's certification work or insurer submission.

The clinician produces the signed document during s1 follow-up; family and insurer supply claimant and policy facts. In s2 the attendant captures exact subject identity, policy reference, claimant details, form version and attachment references. Missing declarations remain blank for manual resolution in s4.
No system creates a doctor's signature, cause-of-death statement or claimant declaration.
Test native document fields first; shared signed documents are produced once in s1 and reused by the permit task, not gathered again in a team roll-up.
unknowns: Whether forms already reuse case data
research_questions: How much form-copying effort remains after the existing case system is used?

already_counted.description: Signature follow-up, verified field capture and paperwork checking

incremental.description: Maintain claim templates and check changed insurer fields

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=50+20+0+15=85; gross 15 minus focal upkeep 5 gives net 10 in an E1 scenario. Range 0-3 allows for existing autofill, diverse insurer forms and unchanged signature follow-up.

tasks.short: Comfort bereaved people and discuss after-care support

steps.what: Attend to bereaved people through comfort, listening and discussion of suitable after-care support

tasks.design: Retain the personal conversation and response to the bereaved person's needs. Existing support information in {DOCS} may be consulted without claiming that consultation replaces care.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task is responsive human support rather than document processing.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automation is needed for the stated task.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising changing needs, respecting boundaries and offering appropriate support.
tasks.human_edge: Presence, empathy and trust are the work.
tasks.altitude: The attendant's responsibilities remain personal and unchanged.

reach.learn: When an expressed need should be referred to specialist support

evidence.claim: Comfort and responsive bereavement support depend on a human relationship; no labour saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is direct support and after-care discussion, not a separate case-documentation process.
The bereaved person expresses needs during s1; the attendant verifies current support options through existing staff knowledge or records. No structured distress or eligibility flags are assumed.
No automated counselling or invented administrative baseline is introduced.
Incremental upkeep is zero because no new system or workflow is proposed.
unknowns: The attendant's training and referral remit
research_questions: Which support needs require referral beyond the attendant's remit?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross and net saving. Direct bereavement support is retained in full.
